Derive the metered flag from ADAPTERS[name].reports_cost, not provider.name == 'claude'. Take the USD basis from the serving row through a public Registry/config accessor. Drop the invented 1.0 default and the private Registry._providers read.

Wire production callers: Stages filesystem-seam output writes go to WatchdogLLM.observe_mutation, and provider-cap wait intervals go to observe_cap_wait (empty when no wait). Do not change CliClient.call. Prove both reach the detector.
Do not add a detector-driven abort. Leave the hard kill to LLMEffect's existing stuck_seconds unwind and record only the spiral: stuck signal. Soft trips never abort; assert the abort count is 0.

Edit test_unrelated_signals_and_hold_release_do_not_notify in place. Keep the bare {'kind': 'watchdog'} exclusion and add soft/stuck delivery. Also add a failing transport followed by a later reconcile that delivers exactly once.

In test_watchdog.py, update the 'dormant' module docstring. Make the positive proof go through the __main__ drain/serve root binding. Assert that default compose_pipeline leaves Stages._watchdog as None.
